To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
the introduction of a 4-phenyl group into the piperazine ring of 4-substituted 2,4-dihydro-3H-1,3-oxazolidin-2-ones results in compounds with potent activity.
the oxazolidinones with 2,4-disubstituted piperazine moiety are more potent than 2-substituted and 4-substituted piperazin-2-yl oxazolidine derivatives.
1,3-oxazolidinone compounds are a new class of potent antibacterial agents, with the most potent compound having an IC50 of 0.1 μg/mL against MRSA.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the design and synthesis of new antibacterial compounds, which are highly potent and have good oral bioavailability.
the design and synthesis of a novel series of 2-substituted 5-oxazolidinone-3-carboxylic acids.
a series of novel 5-substituted 2-(piperazinyl)-1, 3-oxazolidinone and 5-substitued 2-(pyridin-3-yl)-1,3-oxazolin-4-one derivatives, and the structure-activity relationships were studied.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that

the introduction of a 3,5-dichlorophenyl group into the oxazolidin-2-one ring is essential for high antibacterial potency and the 4-methyl-2,6-dimethylpiperazinyl group is essential for high activity.
the 2,2-diaryl-1,3-oxazolidin-4-ones with the substituents of piperazine at the 5-position are the most active compounds.
the introduction of 3, 5-disubstituted piperazin-1-yl oxazolidine-2, 4-diones into the 2-position is an effective strategy to get highly potent antibacterial agents.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
the introduction of a 3-methyl-1-piperazinyl group and a 4-fluoro group on the oxazolidin-2-one ring is very effective in increasing the antibacterial potency.

the introduction of a 2,6-dichloro group to the 2-pyridyl ring and a 3,4-dichloro substituent to the phenyl ring in 2-(4-methylpiperazine-1-yl)-5-oxo-5,6-dihydro-4H-1,3-oxazin-4-yl)-phenyl-1H-imidazole ( 3 ) gave the best result.
the 2-aryl-4-(4-aminopiperidin-1-yl)-oxazolidin-3-ones 4b, 4c, and 5a were found to be the most potent compounds against S. aureus and S. epidermidis, with MIC values ranging from 1.0 to 2.5 μg/ml.
The main takeaway from our work is that
the oxazolidinones containing a piperazinone ring are highly potent and selective against MRSA.
5-aminopiperazinyl-2-oxazolidinone derivative 5d (MIC = 0.5 mg/L) is a promising lead compound for further development as an antibacterial agent.
2,4,5-trisubstituted oxazolidinones with a 3,5-dimethylphenyl group and a 2,2-dimethylpropyl group are highly potent antibacterial agents.
